title: 33 Engines Fire at Once: 16.7 Million Pounds of Thrust

scenes.text: Together they push with 16.7 million pounds of thrust.
That's the Super Heavy booster, the first stage of SpaceX Starship.
Guinness lists it as the most powerful rocket ever launched.
The engines sit in three rings at the bottom of the booster.
Thirty-three engines. Sixteen million pounds. One push.

description:
Thirty-three engines fire at once.
The Super Heavy booster generates about 16.7 million pounds of thrust, and Guinness World Records lists it as the most powerful rocket ever launched.
Would you watch a launch up close? Comment below.
first_comment: Super Heavy has twice the thrust of NASA's SLS moon rocket. Which launch would you most like to see in person?
